sloka: बभूव हि समा भूमि: समन्तात्पञ्चयोजना ।शाद्वलैर्बहुभिश्छन्ना नीलवैडूर्य्यसन्निभै: ॥ २.९१.२९॥
transliteration: babhūva hi samā bhūmi: samantātpañcayojanā ।śādvalairbahubhiśchannā nīlavaiḍūryyasannibhai: ॥ 2.91.29॥

translations.english: The ground was levelled on every side for five yojanas and covered with several grass lawns resembling lapis lazuli (blue sapphire) and cat's eye.
